title: Version 2.1.238 Release (August 21, 2026)
description: Broad update with new prompt and runner settings (keybindingFlavor), tighter MCP and plugin security, more resilient Remote Control and cross-session messaging, improved startup speed and memory leak fixes.

title: New GitHub Copilot Experience in Slack (August 21, 2026)
description: GitHub released a new Copilot integration experience specifically for Slack collaboration tools, representing an expansion of Copilot's presence in team collaboration platforms.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub maintains a dedicated feedback discussion page for the Copilot App and encourages users to provide feedback via comments or the /feedback slash command.

title: Devin Desktop Windows Update Process Improvement (August 21, 2026)
description: Improved update process on Windows for Devin Desktop. This release updates bundled Devin with recent fixes and improvements across Agent Command Center and performance for switching between Agent and Editor mode.

title: Devin CLI Enhancements - New rm Command & Update Repairs (August 21, 2026)
description: Added new devin rm command to delete sessions. devin update can now repair dangling installations. Includes ACP server improvements and better error handling.

title: Version 2.1.237 Release (August 20, 2026)
description: Fixed prompt caching for custom gateways and added built-in Concise output style for faster, result-first responses.

title: Version 2.1.236 Release (August 20, 2026)
description: Added default model setting, cross-session idle notifications, stronger macOS sandbox protections, improved auto mode, Remote Control, startup speed, and VS Code screen reader support.

title: Version 3.1 Series Release - Devin Desktop Integration (August 20, 2026)
description: The 3.1 series builds on the Devin Desktop rebrand with smoother Agent/Editor experience, Devin Local improvements, .devinignore support, ACU usage display, smoother Windows setup, and faster MCP startup.

title: Interactive Agents Dashboard & Apple Messages Integration (August 20, 2026)
description: Added interactive codex agents dashboard for searching, starting, opening, renaming, and stopping tasks with configurable shortcuts. New working-directory commands, queued messaging for existing sessions, enhanced Vim editing, and Apple Messages integration.

title: Weekly Limits Promotion Ending August 19, 2026
description: The 50% higher weekly usage limit promotion that ran from May 13 through August 19, 2026 is ending, reverting to pre-promotion levels. Users discuss concerns about token consumption, model quality changes in Opus 5 and Fable 5, and comparisons with competitors.

community_feedback.quote: The promotion is ending; the limits are reverting to pre-promotion levels. From May 13, 2026 through August 19, 2026, your weekly usage limit in Claude Code is 50% higher.
I just cancelled my Max 5x plan. I was already mad at the limits, now Anthropic says it will get worse? Nah, thanks.
If they remove that extra 50%, I'm moving my $200 to Codex.
During this period however they've released models which lots of people report to be significantly more chatty.

I get incredible utility out of $200 per month. It's hard to put a number on it, but even accounting for all the time in meetings, talking with stakeholders and developers etc I'm over 10% more productive overall.
Claude Code efficiency feels noticeably worse - Aug 19 50% limit cut

title: Cloud Agents & Cursor Harness Improvements (August 19, 2026)
description: Cursor announced automations for always-on cloud agents that can monitor PRs, watch Slack threads, and run scheduled tasks. Improved cloud agent harness enabling agents to work together as a coordinated system.

title: Version 0.57.0-preview.0 Release (August 19, 2026)
description: Preview release with new experimental features including a new tool call formatter and integrated failure handling improvements.

title: Codex Remote and MCP Features (August 18, 2026)
description: New Codex Remote and MCP (Model Context Protocol) features released, expanding capabilities for remote development and tool integration.

community_feedback.quote: Compatibility issues reported on Intel Macs during this period.

title: Origin Code Hosting (August 17, 2026)
description: New Origin Code Hosting feature launched.

title: Reported SpaceX Acquisition (August 14, 2026)
description: Reports of a $60 billion acquisition of Cursor by SpaceX, making Cursor a wholly-owned SpaceX subsidiary. Would be the largest acquisition in tech history if confirmed.

community_feedback.quote: SpaceX says it has agreement to acquire Cursor for $60B. Cursor's run rate is on track to surpass $6 billion by the end of 2026.
Cursor makes a ton of money on its AI IDE. What's crazy is that a company that sells an IDE (that's not even an original product, it's a VS Code fork) is worth $60B.
SpaceX bought Cursor for its user base, that's it.
Cursor sits closer to proprietary source code. SpaceX will store them and use them as well.
Users expressing anxiety about Cursor being closer to SpaceX's proprietary source code and calling for Privacy Mode to protect code.

title: Copilot CLI Enhancements with Gemini 3.7 Flash Support (August 15, 2026)
description: Added Gemini 3.7 Flash model support, new sandbox environment, improved usage metrics, smoother scheduling controls. Fixed ACP permissions and prompt-related issues.

title: Chat Upgrades with Better Models and Context (August 15, 2026)
description: Latest update supercharges chat experience with better models, better context, and more control over the code items Codeium looks at.

title: Cloud Agents Start 3x Faster with Builds (August 13, 2026)
description: Cloud agent startup performance improved by 3x with build caching.

title: Grok 4.6 Integration Live (August 12, 2026)
description: Grok 4.6 is now live in both Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, marked as a significant improvement over Grok 4.5 on FrontierCode 1.1.

title: Model Deprecation Notice - MAI-Code-1-Flash (August 10, 2026)
description: GitHub announced MAI-Code-1-Flash will be deprecated across all Copilot experiences on September 10, 2026, replaced by MAI-Code-1.1-Flash. Users advised to update workflows and integrations.

title: Version 0.55.1 Stable Release (August 11, 2026)
description: Latest stable release recommended for most users. Includes tool registry discovery, enhanced security, stronger sandbox protections, and broad fixes for release verification, authentication, streaming, and session management.

title: CLI Changelog Update (August 11, 2026)
description: CLI improvements including steering and subagents, skills/custom modes/goals, models, MCP and plugins, terminal and rendering, approvals and security.
